email_structure: Specific pain points for their industry, not generic pitches
No hard sell, spark curiosity to drive toward a call
Open with something specific to THEM (name, company, industry pain)
Feels like a text from a smart friend, not a sales pitch
subject_lines: Use their first name or company name
No clickbait, no ALL CAPS, no exclamation marks
Reference something specific about their business
ctas_that_work: What days work for a call?
Want to see how this works for {company}?
winning_patterns.sign_off: Always sign off as just 'Dylan' (first name only, no title, no company)

never_do: NEVER use dashes (--), em dashes, or en dashes anywhere in messaging
NEVER write long emails (keep under 120 words)
NEVER use generic openers like 'I hope this email finds you well'
NEVER use a formal tone or sound robotic
NEVER use buzzwords: synergy, leverage, revolutionize, game-changer, cutting-edge
NEVER fully answer questions over email (redirect to call)
NEVER use phrases: 'just bumping this', 'circling back', 'following up on my last email', 'checking in'
NEVER reply to hostile or rude messages
NEVER use 'Re:' prefix on subject lines
NEVER include multiple CTAs in one email
NEVER use flattery like 'love what you're doing' or 'impressive growth'
NEVER use generic filler like 'I came across your company'

tone_guidelines.overall: Casual, confident, value-driven. Like texting a friend who happens to have something useful.
rules: Speak to pain points and desired outcomes
Empathize first, then reframe with logic or social proof

objection_handling.framework: Imperium Method: empathize first, reframe with logic/social proof, end with low-friction CTA

direct_intent.description: Prospect wants to book or learn more
direct_intent.strategy: Send Calendly link immediately. Keep it short and excited.
direct_intent.example_response: Great to hear you're interested. Easiest next step is to grab a time on my calendar: calendly.com/realsideai

how_does_it_work.strategy: Redirect to call. Say it's best explained on a demo. Don't try to explain everything over email.
how_does_it_work.example_response: Totally fair question. Honestly, the best way to get it is a quick demo where I can walk you through a live example. 15 minutes, no pressure.

how_much.strategy: First attempt: deflect to call. If they push: anchor price ($2K/mo) to result (40 pre-qualified appointments).
how_much.example_response_first: Great question. Pricing depends on your volume and setup. Rather than throw out a number without context, let me walk you through the ROI on a quick call so you can see exactly what you'd get.
how_much.example_response_pushed: We charge $2,000 per month. Assuming we can land you 40 pre-qualified appointments booked in your calendar every month, would you be happy to demo it out with me?

send_proof.strategy: Offer to walk through case studies on a demo call. Don't just dump proof in email.
send_proof.example_response: We've got some great case studies. I'd love to walk you through them with full context on a quick call. I can even put you in touch with clients afterwards.

not_interested.strategy: Record 60-second Loom to break the pattern. Tag in Instantly, do not re-email.
not_interested.example_response: No worries at all. If anything changes, door's always open.

tried_before.description: Tried AI or similar before, didn't work
tried_before.strategy: Differentiate Realside (custom-built, natural voices, brand-tuned). Offer proof via demo.
tried_before.example_response: Totally get it. Most AI tools out there are cookie-cutter. We custom-build every system for each business. Would 15 minutes to see the difference be worth it?

already_have.description: Already has a solution in place
already_have.strategy: Acknowledge current solution. Plant a seed about what they might be missing (speed-to-lead, CRM reactivation).
already_have.example_response: Glad you've got something in place. Just curious, are they handling outbound reactivation of your old database too? That's where most of our clients see the biggest ROI.

timing.strategy: Respect timing. Offer future touchpoint. Stay top-of-mind.
timing.example_response: Totally understand. When would be a better time? Happy to circle back whenever it makes sense for you.
